Landing.badge: Home finance control with an AI assistant
Landing.heroSubtitle: Scrooge is a home budgeting app. Budget vs. actuals, liabilities, investments, taxes, savings goals, an AI assistant — all in one place, secure and private.
Landing.screensSubtitle: One app, a complete picture of your finances — from monthly budget to investment portfolio.
Landing.featuresSubtitle: Years of running a home budget in Excel spreadsheets, redesigned as a modern web app.

features.title: Budget vs. Actuals
features.description: Plan a monthly budget with templates and track spending in real time. Instant alerts when you go over plan.

features.title: AI Financial Assistant
features.description: Ask about your finances in plain language. Bring your own LLM — OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or a custom provider.

features.title: Liabilities, Taxes & Enforcement
features.description: Track loans, credit, instalments and subscriptions, tax settlements and enforcement proceedings — all in one place.

features.title: Investments
features.description: Track your portfolio: stocks, bonds, ETFs, crypto, precious metals, deposits and more — with one aggregated value.

features.title: Savings Goals
features.description: Set financial goals and monitor progress towards them as you go.

features.title: Trend Analysis
features.description: Spot spending patterns across months and years. Forecasts based on real data — up to 10 years of history.

features.title: Interactive Charts & Reports
features.description: Ready-made charts: cost breakdown, income, overspending. Export data for further analysis.

features.title: Excel Data Import
features.description: Import your transaction history from an Excel spreadsheet. Deduplication and preview before it's saved.

features.title: Security
features.description: Passwordless login (OTP), Row Level Security in Supabase. Your data is visible only to you.

steps.title: Sign in with email
steps.description: Enter your email and get a one-time code. No passwords to remember.

steps.title: Set up categories and accounts
steps.description: Set up a category hierarchy (Food > Restaurants), add your bank accounts, cash, crypto and investments.

steps.title: Plan your budget
steps.description: Create a budget template and generate monthly plans from it. Import your history from Excel.

steps.title: Track and analyse
steps.description: Log transactions, browse charts, ask the AI assistant about your finances. Stay on top of it.

Landing.securityBody: Passwordless login (OTP), encrypted data in Supabase, Row Level Security — no one but you can access your finances. AI conversations are stored locally on your device.
Landing.ctaTitle: Ready to take control of your finances?
Landing.ctaSubtitle: Scrooge is launching soon. Join the waitlist and be first in line when we open access.
